entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan
 Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is facing a trial for accusation of committing offence under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Upon his appearance before the trial court, he moved an application under Section 13 (2) of the PFA Act for re-examination of the sample.
His application was allowed and the authorities were directed to produce the sample for sending it to CFL.

Thereafter, for long period of five years, the sample was not produced in the Court by the officers for the purpose of sending the same to CFL for its `re-examnation and now shelf life of the commodity has expired.

He placed reliance on the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Girishbhai Dayabhai Shah Vs.
C.C.Jani & Ors., 2009 15 SCC 64.

entities.text:
Girishbhai Dayabhai Shah Vs.
C.C.Jani & Ors., 2009 15 SCC 64
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Issue notice, returnable within two weeks.
Learned public prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Let notice be issued to respondent No.2.

In the meanwhile, further proceedings in the Criminal Case No.
7533/2014 pending before ACJM No.1, Bhilwara shall remain stayed.

(FARJAND ALI),J 106-Arti/-
